description: Remote guard. When the project is local-only (.enabler/local-only exists, or git.local_only is true in .enabler/config.json) it blocks git push, gh/glab writes, write requests to GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket, and writes through GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Jira or Confluence MCP tools. Does nothing otherwise. Source guard, always on: refuses edits inside the external sources registered in .enabler/sources/sources.json, which the pipeline only reads. Scout guard, always on: refuses a background command from delivery-repo-scout or delivery-source-scout, which run every command in the foreground. Output trim, for the delivery subagents only: when a test or build runner prints more than output_trim.max_chars, saves the full output under .enabler/tmp/output/ and shows the agent the failures with their context, the summary, the first and the last lines, and the path of the full log; never blocks. Gate notification: when Claude Code has been idle for about a minute and a delivery run in this project waits at a gate (plan, ship, delta, coverage, blocked), raises one desktop notification per wait; never blocks; notify.gates: false turns it off.
